OGTR named the council area this site is in and published no coordinate on the page this was read from, so this marker sits in that council area and not at the trial itself. WHY IT MATTERS. OGTR names the council area of every licensed site, its area in hectares and the licence it runs under. No other register on this map states where a release is at all, which is the comparison worth making even at this resolution.

11.41682,55.29547.name: Ellegaard Göttingen Minipigs A/S
11.41682,55.29547.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-97.16332,49.90859.name: National Centre for Foreign Animal Disease
-97.16332,49.90859.desc: A BSL4 animal laboratory, operational. Run by Canadian Food Inspection Agency. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 100 SqM. Operational or announced: 1998. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

78.96000,20.59000.name: India — no public clinic register
78.96000,20.59000.desc: India regulates assisted reproduction under a 2021 Act and prohibited commercial surrogacy, but publishes no register of licensed clinics. Estimates of the number operating run into the thousands.

78.96000,20.59000.name: India — no public facility register
78.96000,20.59000.desc: Experiments are overseen by a national committee that has banned animal use for cosmetics testing and some teaching, but facility-level records are not public.

6.14300,46.20400.name: International Federation of Biosafety Associations
6.14300,46.20400.desc: A non-governmental federation of national and regional biosafety associations, providing training and professional certification in biorisk management. In most countries there is no licence to work in a containment laboratory, so a voluntary certificate from an international federation is the only credential the role has.
